verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents how long CloudConvert keeps uploaded files or when converted files are deleted. The only privacy-related item says team files stay private under shared billing, which is about access, not retention or deletion timing. Retention is a fair question for a hosted converter, so the absence of documentation makes this "none", not "na".

support.subject: As an ops lead, a hosted converter documents how long uploads are kept and when converted files are deleted
